Celebrity Real Estate on Instagram: "Step inside Rory McIlroy’s stunning $22 million Florida mansion! 🏌️‍♂️

Located in the exclusive Bear’s Club community in Jupiter, this 12,800 sq ft estate was purchased from golf legend Ernie Els in 2017 for $11 million and has since appreciated significantly in value.

The luxurious residence boasts seven bedrooms, ten bathrooms, a state-of-the-art recording studio, a home cinema, a fitness gym, and a resort-style outdoor area complete with a tennis court and swimming pool.

Situated on a spacious lot, the property offers privacy and tranquility, surrounded by lush landscaping and mature trees.

📍 Jupiter, Florida
7 Bed | 10 Bath | 12,800 SqFt

Check out this property on Homes.com!"
